sources.mass: User confirmed total mass 2kg including airframe and battery. Component masses and inertia unmeasured.
sources.inertia: Unmeasured central equivalent uniform cylinder r=.10m h=.30m, total2kg. Conservative engineering assumption, not inferred from shell volume or weighing.
sources.rotor: Assumed .004kg per propeller, uniform three-blade disc inertia. Motor bell inertia omitted.
sources.motor: T-MOTOR official P2207 V3 1950KV / 6S / P49436-3 thrust-RPM table. Reaction torque = thrust * .01m is an UNMEASURED assumption; response time constants also assumed.
sources.aerodynamics: No identified airframe lift/drag. Rotor-supported low-speed MC only; no fixed-wing transition or aerodynamic similarity claim.
sources.geometry: User ten STL parts share assembly coordinates; units assumed millimeters. Rx(+90deg), centered at raw [0,1013.5,0]. Rotor plane rawY998.5mm is assumed, not mounting confirmation.

limitations: User confirms total2kg including battery/airframe, not 2kg additional payload.
No measured CG/inertia, motor reaction torque, battery sag/endurance, rotor inflow or body aerodynamic model.
Official 28.1mm motor diameter exceeds STL pod 27mm inner diameter. Physical fit is NOT verified.
No fixed-wing conversion: wings/fins have no measured polar for the new load.
Simulation only: no hardware launch, no ground-truth target control, no pose teleporting.
Camera and avionics are visual-only partitions within the existing assumed 2kg total; no measured component mass or updated inertia is claimed.
Camera Module 3 bracket adapter and cable route are concept visuals; narrow nominal clearances are not a manufacturing fit verification.

Camera drawing total 11.3mm and interpreted sub-dimensions 2.75+1.12+6.98=10.85mm differ by 0.45mm; the optical origin is a simulation assumption pending mechanical datum and entrance-pupil measurement.
mass_specification: User confirmed 2kg TOTAL including airframe and battery; component mass split not measured.

onboard_camera.model: Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 standard (concept mounting)
onboard_camera.placement_source: User assembly section; official PCB/lens dimensions; adapter, optical center and component mounting are simulation assumptions, NOT manufacturing approval.
onboard_camera.mount_status: Concept adapter: old holes x=+/-10.5,z=-5 only; rails y1202..1203,z-13.9..1.6; new posts z=-12.4,+.1 y1203..1205. Original 1.8mm holes are not verified M2 clearance.
onboard_camera.clearance_status: Ideal mesh envelope only: PCB-to-shell approx0.333mm, rear connector-to-bracket0.25mm. Tolerances, wiring, cooling and mechanical strength unverified.
onboard_camera.optics_status: Ideal fixed-focus pinhole, 66deg nominal horizontal FOV, 640x360 downsampled simulation. No measured calibration, autofocus, distortion, exposure or rolling shutter.

internal_visuals.status: VISUAL ONLY: approximate placement read from user section; no component mass/inertia addition, actual dimensions and mounting must be measured.
